run_scene_aabb_example: run the pybullet sceneAABB example that loads a plane and sphere and prints their combined bounding box
getSceneAABB: get the axis-aligned bounding box min and max coordinates for all bodies in the pybullet simulation scene
p_getAABB: get the axis-aligned bounding box for a specific body unique ID in the pybullet simulation
p_loadURDF: load a URDF geometry file into the pybullet simulation at a specified position
p_stepSimulation: step the pybullet physics simulation forward by one configured time step
